interpretations: Filter films to `rental_duration >= 5`, group by `original_language_id` with all NULL IDs in one group, and calculate each group’s average `rental_rate` and film count. Return one unrounded row containing the equally weighted average of the group rental-rate averages, followed by the equally weighted average of the group film counts; ignore missing values and return missing for either figure if no groups remain.
queries:
WITH language_groups AS (
  SELECT
    original_language_id,
    AVG(rental_rate) AS average_rental_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film
  WHERE rental_duration >= 5
  GROUP BY original_language_id
)
SELECT
  AVG(average_rental_rate),
  AVG(film_count)
FROM language_groups
